status_summary: No department-wide audit modeled on the Defense Department audit was found. In February 2025 VA reviewed its contracts, with contracting officials told on 2025-02-21 to review 1,049 contract actions in under 11 hours, and VA senior advisers and DOGE representatives directed terminations on 2025-02-25. A VA Inspector General review reported on 2026-09-24 found 435 contract actions worth about $1.1 billion had been terminated and that VA's lists of terminations sent to Congress were incomplete and inaccurate. The review was a contract-termination exercise rather than an audit of IT, management and finance, so it is recorded as a parallel step.

timeline.event: VA contracting officials were told to review 1,049 contract actions in under 11 hours as part of a department contract review.
